name: PublishPipelineArtifactDev
description: Test-only Node replacement using an explicit local ArtifactTool build. Not for production.
helpMarkDown: Uses a trusted local ArtifactTool executable in the normal task target, including containers. Does not download tools or invoke agent plug-ins.
author: Microsoft Corporation

inputs.name: artifactToolPath
inputs.label: Local development ArtifactTool executable
inputs.helpMarkDown: Absolute executable path visible inside the task target. Must be a trusted development build with pipeline artifact metadata and pattern support. No tool download or PATH lookup is performed.

inputs.name: path
inputs.label: File or directory path
inputs.helpMarkDown: File or directory to publish; relative paths use System.DefaultWorkingDirectory. Wildcards are not supported.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Defaults to the normalized job identifier. Strict artifact name validation is always enabled in this development task.

inputs.name: fileSharePath
inputs.label: File share path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Windows-only share accessible to the normal task target, not implicitly to the host.

inputs.name: parallelCount
inputs.label: Parallel count
inputs.helpMarkDown: Copy parallelism from 1 to 128; out-of-range values are clamped with a warning.

inputs.name: properties
inputs.label: Custom properties
inputs.helpMarkDown: JSON object of strings with user- prefixed keys.

messages.DevelopmentOnly: Development-only task: invoking a trusted local ArtifactTool build. Production tasks and YAML shortcuts are unchanged.
